# Raúl Wesche

> Raúl Wesche (also written Raul Wesche; Instagram @weschetattoo, 297K followers) is a geometric and sacred geometry tattoo artist and painter based in Houston, Texas, with 12+ years of experience. He works in large-scale geometric work — mandalas, Platonic solids, Flower of Life, Metatron's Cube, dotwork and blackwork — in full-day sessions.

This file is about the artist and how to book him. It does not repeat product copy from the shop or a biography of his other brands. Those sites should point back to https://wesche.com/about.html.

## Tattoo bookings

- Studio: Tattoo Temple Houston, Houston, TX. The studio lease ends March 2027. The street address and studio phone are published in exactly one place: the TattooParlor node in this site's JSON-LD (`https://wesche.com/#studio`). Remove that node when the studio closes. This file does not repeat the street address.
- How to book: https://wesche.com/booking.html or email booking@weschetattoo.com (the booking email published on the site).
- Format: full-day sessions. Clients travel from other states.
- Books status: the booking page says books are currently closed, and inquiries can join the waiting list. Check https://wesche.com/booking.html before promising an opening.

## Projects founded by Raúl Wesche

- [Vesica Studio](https://vesica.studio/): sacred geometry drawing tool (the app is at https://app.vesica.studio/). One-line credit on that site should link to https://wesche.com/about.html.
- [OMF Geometry](https://omfgeometry.com/) / Instagram @omfgeometry: directory and magazine for geometric tattoo artists. The site describes the Facebook community as 45,000+ members: https://www.facebook.com/groups/941185070937437
- [Wear Vesica](https://wearvesica.com/): his clothing brand. As of October 2026 the storefront returns a password page. Link it as the clothing brand and point its about text at https://wesche.com/about.html instead of copying this bio.
